title: Pocketwire Personal Account Deposit Benefit: Milestone Direct-Deposit Supplement in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
The Pocketwire Rewards quarterly milestone bonus carries a direct-deposit supplement for members whose linked Pocketwire Personal Account is on a paid plan and received direct deposits over the last three months.

## Clause

The milestone direct-deposit supplement is 2000 points when the direct deposits received by the linked personal account within the last three months total at least 9000 USD and that account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit; it is 800 points when the account does not meet that first condition but its direct deposits within the last three months total at least 3000 USD and it is on Pocketwire Plus, Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit; and it is nothing otherwise. The supplement is added to the quarterly milestone bonus credited, in whole points.

The records read are the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account and the direct deposit entries on that account's ledger. A date lies within the last three months when it is later than the same calendar day three months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Supplement by plan and deposits

| Plan of the linked personal account | Direct deposits within the last three months | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit | 9000 USD or more | 2000 points |
| Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit | 3000 USD or more, below 9000 USD | 800 points |
| Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime | 3000 USD or more | 800 points |
| any of these four plans | below 3000 USD | nothing |
| Pocketwire Lite or Pocketwire Core | any amount | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Pocketwire Prime account with 9500.00 USD of direct deposits in the window: the first condition needs Onyx or Summit; 800 points.
- A Pocketwire Onyx account with exactly 9000.00 USD: 2000 points.
